summary: Wire the live application profiler's measured clock, record exit, seconds conversion and reset; replace the reciprocal QPC scale with the binary's own calibration.

rows.evidence: 00BE3310 listing: QPC, Sleep(100), QPC, signed 64-bit delta * 10. 00CD8F30 stores the returned ticks/second in 0109DB48. The adapter forwards actual Windows QPC and Sleep; the profiler retains that measured value for the existing end-frame consumer. OFF retains the old QueryPerformanceFrequency reciprocal path.

Replace the identical inlined record-exit operation at 00BE3679..00BE36B2. The body owns the depth decrement and samples the same ProfilerClockHost only on the outermost exit, writing the live accumulator and last_exit. The adapter rejects Sleep, which this body never calls. The old decrement and sample remain only in OFF.

The actual accumulated ticks and calibrated scale produce the history/current values consumed by the profiler. 00BE3360 --asm shows FILD qword, FDIV double, FSTP float, FLD float. Corrected the existing body to keep this sequence on MSVC Win32: it preserves signed int64 input above 2^53 and inherits the caller's x87 precision, including main-thread PC24. No second body was introduced.

Replace the inlined clear after history aggregation with the existing body over the same live record. Only accumulator, depth and hit_count are cleared; first_entry and last_exit survive for the immediately following offset calculations. OFF retains the original inline clear.
